    Exception lane

    Filters

    Buy at instasell (low), sell at instabuy (high). Margin is net of GE tax. The volume filter gates on the thinner side of the book — a round trip needs sellers to buy from and buyers to sell to, so the sum of both sides overstated liquidity roughly 2×. Under 5k gp it's a unit floor; at 5k+ it's a gp-flow floor (thin-side units × price per hour) — unit counts understate mid-tier liquidity, gp-flow doesn't.

      Inventory — market-maker mode

      Item Target Held At cost At market P/L % stack
      Lots are FIFO: buy filled… records a lot at your fill price, sold… consumes the oldest lots and prefills the flip log with their true cost — nothing is ever logged for you. The flip log decides which items qualify: rows earn an mm-ready badge (5+ profitable recent flips, clean markouts, fills inside the horizon) with a suggested buffer. Click the badge — or the mm button in the row's Actions column — to set it. A standing buffer is a commitment of capital, not a flip, so enabling it is always your press.
      Row dots — shape is the identity, colour is the state inside it, and the two families never share a colour meaning: ◉ paper-profitable · ◉ paper-losing · ◎ shadow: the margin exists, the fills don't · ◌ shadow accruing (under 3 closed trips — no verdict yet) · ● margin test verified · ○ margin test expired. Shadow states are circles-within-circles and carry good/bad colour because they ARE good/bad; test states are plain circles in neutral steel because verified-vs-stale is not good-vs-bad. Each dot keeps a fixed slot, so a missing one leaves its space rather than letting its neighbour slide over.

      Thesis sleeve — catalyst positions

      Judged at exit, not at the mark. The sleeve proposes and surfaces SELL cards when exit rungs arm; you execute in-game and confirm every fill. Sleeve gp never blends into a flipping metric — no shared velocity, no sleeve gp in the couch-minute Sharpe. Entries, exits, phase flags, ladder edits, and thesis-health lights are all your presses, and the material ones land in the decision log.

      Intelligence — ratification queue

      SUSPECTED PUMP benches sleeve candidacy, applies a seed-style caution cap in the plan (half-size, one slot, never wins-graduated while flagged), and states its reason on every surface. The posture is absence. Dismissing the warning record lifts it. Typed records from the analyst briefing — each with its thesis, sources, confidence tier, and expiry. Ratify / edit-then-ratify / dismiss; every ruling is decision-logged, dismissals are remembered (Jaccard ≥ 0.6 overlap absorption; a dismissed story resurfaces only on material change). Intel cannot touch the blacklist, the proven-loser bench, realized metrics, gate constants, or the reserve — where intel and your realized history disagree, history wins and the copy says so.

      Catalyst calendar & entry watch

      Per catalyst, ↻ screen entries reads each linked item's 90-day daily series and states DISCOUNTED (below baseline — thesis intact) vs RAMPING (price and volume rising together — others are front-running; late-entry warning), ranked by discount depth × catalyst proximity × exit liquidity. Proposes only — nothing enters the sleeve without your press on the form below.

      Item baskets — exposure caps & blast radius

      One story, many tickers — correlated positions are one bet. Everything here proposes; nothing caps capital until you confirm.
      how baskets work A basket attached to a calendar catalyst is that catalyst's item basket — its coherence renders in the catalyst's entry watch above. A basket with no catalyst is a STANDING BASKET, kept for the two jobs that need no date: exposure caps and update-day blast-radius warnings. The weekly detector, wiki categories, the seed list and the coherence screen only propose into the review queue below.

      Coherence-driven membership (ruled Aug 2026): adds need excess corr > 0.5 vs the basket composite in ≥3 of the last 4 weekly readings, drops need < 0.25 for 4 straight — persistence, not snapshots, and net of the market factor, precisely because chasing raw co-movement admits coincidences. A basket groomed purely by realized correlation converges on describing the past, not the thesis — so statistical members (co-movement without a story) cap at 40% of membership and are excluded from entry-watch narratives and laggard logic while still counting toward the exposure cap. (Formerly the Clusters tab — merged here Aug 2026; membership ratification unchanged.)
      BasketMembers Exposure / cap Cap % P&L 14d P&L all

      Basket coherence — is it still moving as one?

      Pick a basket's detail… button (or a catalyst's basket coherence… button above) to see whether — and to what extent — its correlation is holding: the pairwise excess-correlation matrix, a rolling correlation-over-time view to watch the thesis decay, and the members' normalized 31-day charts overlaid. Thesis health is a question that lives next to the thesis.

      Accumulation anomaly scan — weekly

      Items over 1m gp showing a sustained price+volume rise across 2–3 weeks with no linked catalyst — flagged "being accumulated — reason unknown; find the catalyst before considering entry". Max 5 flags a week, by anomaly strength. No thesis, no position — a flag is a homework assignment, never an entry signal.

      Attention & dormancy

      on demand — the check that catches surfaces you stopped using
      Press to run. Reports the walk-up decision-count trend against its ≤7 budget, features untouched for 90+ days proposed for demotion, and any tier assignment your usage contradicts. Advisory: nothing here demotes or deletes anything on its own.

      📖 Glossary — every term this tool renders

      Every entry says what it means, what produces it, and what decision it should change for you — the last line is the point; a dictionary that stops at the definition makes you do the translation every time. Tap any gate name in a bench reason to land on its entry.

      Tax rules implemented

      2% of the sale price, deducted when the sell fills, rounded down per item, capped at 5,000,000 gp per item. Rate rose from 1% to 2% on 29 May 2025. Items selling below 50 gp owe nothing, and 48 items are explicitly exempt, tagged no tax. Verified against the OSRS Wiki. Data: RuneLite / OSRS Wiki real-time prices — polled no faster than 60s, with backoff when the API is unhappy.
